statement: At v7.3-rc1, hid-steam.c lines 1589-1631 selects wired IBEX using the first HID collection usage (rejecting the receiver pogo usage FF00:0002), without consulting a USB parent or interface number. The probe calls this filter after hid_parse (1735-1760). The device table at 2751-2770 matches wired IBEX as a USB-bus HID device. This establishes the source selection path, not successful initialization or report delivery on UHID.

applicability.scope: Consumer evidence only; no physical observation or device-side protocol promotion
